blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday warned local government units (LGUs) against corruption in the use of P8.6 billion in disaster funds, saying those who profit from the suffering of their fellow Filipinos would face legal consequences. Marcos issued the warning during the ceremonial turnover of Disaster Rehabilitation and Reconstruction Assistance Program (DRRAP) funds to disaster-hit LGUs at the Ceremonial Hall of Malacañang Palace. The national government has allocated P8.6 billion in rehabilitation and reconstruction assistance to 306 LGUs to help them recover from the impacts of typhoons, earthquakes and the 2024–2026 Kanlaon Volcano eruption.
